correctness.rationale: The cubic-projective bijection is exact for invertible matrices; nonzero cubics with 0, 2, 3 distinct rational roots are counted explicitly. Singular rank-one matrices are subtracted using their linear times diagonal quadratic factor, with separate odd/even characteristic cases. N_1 follows by complement; symbolic counting is valid for every q including q=2. Eight exhaustive finite-field direct checks corroborate independent of proof.
